LanguageData.RHAH_Warlord_SuicideSquadText: These helpless young ratkin have been taken hostage and used by the ratkin warlords. They have been taught that they will never see their mothers again unless they destroy our colony. The warlords are counting on our sympathy, too. If we choose not to attack, the children may be disposed of. Attacking them would violate our most basic sense of decency. Perhaps we can find a way to keep them safe while stopping them from attacking us?
LanguageData.RHAH_Warlord_MutilatedChildren_Text: The ratkin warlords kidnapped these unsuspecting young ratkin from across the world, harvested their valuable organs, and dumped them here like rubbish. What should we do? Taking in so many children could put a strain on the colony, but our allies refuse to accept them because of their disabilities.
LanguageData.RHAH_Warlord_BombardmentText: Our inaction has emboldened the warlords. They have even fired mortar shells at these young ratkin, then broadcast the incident to nearby factions. Those factions now think less of us.
